derivatives.name: nahb_hmi
derivatives.definition: NAHB/Wells Fargo Housing Market Index level — bounded 0-100 builder-sentiment diffusion index, 50 = neutral; SA by NAHB

derivatives.name: nahb_hmi_diff_3m
derivatives.definition: 3-month POINT change (index points; natural bounded-index momentum)

derivatives.name: nahb_hmi_diff_12m
derivatives.definition: 12-month POINT change (index points; level-independent annual momentum)

derivatives.name: nahb_hmi_ma12_idx
derivatives.definition: 12-month moving average of the level (trend input)

derivatives.name: nahb_hmi_dev_trend_pct
derivatives.definition: % deviation of the level from its 12M MA

derivatives.name: nahb_hmi_zscore_60m
derivatives.definition: rolling 60-month z-score of the LEVEL (first-class: mean-reverting bounded index)

derivatives.name: nahb_hmi_diff12_zscore_60m
derivatives.definition: rolling 60-month z-score of the 12M point change

derivatives.name: nahb_hmi_above50
derivatives.definition: binary regime flag: HMI > 50 = net builder optimism (native diffusion-index line)

derivatives.name: hmm_2state_prob_stress
derivatives.definition: P(builder-pessimism regime) from 2-state HMM on the level (level-regime split, deliberate)

derivatives.name: markov_regime_2state
derivatives.definition: P(high-variance regime) from Markov-switching regression spy_ret~level

notes: ECON-SD: only NAHB HMI derivatives and SPY derivatives are in scope. Controls in the parquet (unrate, dgs10, fed_funds, vix) are context columns, NOT signals. Bounded 0-100 diffusion index: level/point-diff/z-score first-class; %-transforms carry the bounded_pct_risk flag. SA source — no seasonal-contamination constraint. regime_story: false (CP2 skipped).
